title: VOLTA Daily Briefing
description: A daily two-host briefing on AI, UAP, quantum and breakthrough computing, and cutting-edge physics, weighted toward neuromorphic computing, brain-computer interfaces, quantum memristors and photonics. Every claim is cited in the show notes.
author: VOLTA OS

hosts.name: Mira
hosts.persona: Lead host. Sharp, warm, quick to connect dots and ask the pointed question.

hosts.name: Dex
hosts.persona: Co-host. Dry humour, technically deep, likes to stress-test claims and explain the mechanism.

topics.label: Neuromorphic computing
topics.brief: Spiking neural networks, event-based sensors, in-memory/analog compute, memristive hardware, chips such as Loihi, Hala Point, SpiNNaker, NorthPole, and brain-inspired architectures.

topics.label: Brain-computer interfaces
topics.brief: Implanted and non-invasive BCIs, neural decoding, speech/motor neuroprostheses, trials and regulatory milestones (Neuralink, Synchron, Precision, Blackrock, academic labs).

topics.label: Quantum memristors
topics.brief: Quantum memristors, memristive quantum devices and photonic quantum memory-with-history elements, quantum reservoir computing and quantum neuromorphic ideas.

topics.label: Photonics and optical computing
topics.brief: Photonic and optical computing, silicon photonics, photonic neural networks and accelerators, integrated photonic chips, co-packaged optics, photonic quantum hardware.

topics.label: AI
topics.brief: The most significant AI developments: frontier model releases, agents, major research results, safety and policy decisions, big compute or funding moves.

topics.label: Quantum and breakthrough computing
topics.brief: Quantum computing hardware and error-correction milestones, quantum advantage claims, new qubit modalities, plus other breakthrough computing (new compute paradigms, major chips).

topics.label: Cutting-edge physics
topics.brief: Frontier physics results: particle and astro physics, condensed matter and materials breakthroughs, fusion, gravitational waves, dark matter, new states of matter, major collaborations.

topics.label: UAP
topics.brief: UAP/UFO news: government disclosures, AARO and congressional activity, FOIA releases, credible sensor data and scientific analysis. Treat claims as claims and say who made them.
